reference.title: Joining a subordinate station using export tags
reference.shortdesc: When you use export tags to join a subordinate station to a station, on the subordinate's SubordinateExportTagNetworkExt Join Profile property sheet, you can configure a reciprocal NiagaraStation connection from the station back to the subordinate station at join time.

section.p: The Default Fox Over WebSocket and Default Fox Over WebSocket Port correspond directly to the Fox Over WebSocket and Fox Over WebSocket Port properties in the Fox Client Connection (see fox-FoxClientConnection in ) of the NiagaraStation created in the 's NiagaraNetwork at join time. As with the existing Default Subordinate Port property, the Default Fox Over WebSocket Port property is a format that you can use to look up the HTTPS port from the subordinate's WebService for the reciprocal connection (default value), or you can specify a port directly.
